title: Enterprise Master Services Agreement
content: Section 4. Payment Terms. Customer must pay all undisputed invoices within thirty calendar days of invoice date. If any payment is returned unpaid, Vendor may collect return or insufficient funds fee. Section 9. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon 60 days prior written notice. During any period of material breach, Vendor may suspend services for security risks or material breach. Section 14. Confidentiality. Neither party will disclose confidential information to any third party without prior written consent.
